decision_conditions: LB Ext and Int works to match existing
LBC works in accord with apprvd plans
description:
Internal and external repair works to the front bay of a Grade II listed building, together with associated external repair, restoration and redecoration works, including structural repairs where required. The works are repair-led, carried out on a like-for-like basis, and do not involve any alteration to the appearance or layout of the building.

Internal works comprise localised opening up and making good to facilitate structural strengthening to the front bay, including the installation of concealed steel beams and columns in accordance with an engineer’s design, with associated temporary propping, localised removal and reinstatement of finishes, and full making good on completion. All disturbed elements, including ceilings, floors, joinery and decorations, will be reinstated to match existing.

External works to the front bay comprise localised dismantling and repair of defective elements to enable structural stabilisation, including careful removal and rebuilding of limited areas of masonry and rendered surfaces where required, followed by reinstatement to match existing profiles, detailing and finishes. No changes are proposed to the form, proportions or visual appearance of the bay.

Associated external works comprise repair, restoration and redecoration of existing external elements, including stucco and masonry repairs, crack stitching, timber joinery repairs, metalwork repairs and redecoration, roof and rainwater goods repairs, and external finishes. Works are limited to repair and reinstatement using matching materials and methods.

The proposals do not involve complete demolition of the listed building. Any localised removal of fabric is limited, temporary and solely required to enable repair and reinstatement. The works are repair-led, carried out on a like-for-like basis, and do not involve any alteration to the building’s layout or external appearance.
